correctness.rationale: For odd p and e>=2, units U are cyclic of N=(p-1)p^{e-1}. Every nonconstant unital multiplicative endomorphism fixes zero and is F_{t,a}(p^ku)=a^k u^t with t mod N and a∈pR; the proof checks independence of chosen unit representative. Composition idempotence is t²=t mod N and F(a)=a. If nonzero val(a)>=2, the image valuation grows to v² and equality is impossible; if a=pc with c mod p^{e-1} a unit, then c^t=1 mod p^{e-1} with gcd(t,phi_{e-1}) choices. For a=0 images have 1+h_e(t) points; for val(a)=1 the disjoint nonzero valuation strata yield 1+Σ_{j=1}^e h_j(t). CRT over exact prime-power factors gives total 1+2^{ω(p-1)+1}+(1+p^{e-2})Π_{ℓ^b||p-1}(1+ℓ^b). Independent exhaustive multiplication/composition of constructed maps for Z/27 yields exactly 17 maps, including the nine image-size buckets. The constant-one map is the unique exception to zero preservation.
